cost: k lexical tokens: O(k) fixed-table comparisons plus four-element sort. Dictionary suffix lookup O(log D) comparisons each. Fact normalization/lookup add upstream cost; cache retrieval clones output. TSV O(B+r log D) comparison-weighted with stored accepted strings.
description: Lexical operation, numeric extraction and record overrides
forward: entry_word lowercases, prefers exact record, then ordered suffix candidates of length>2. op_of selects frozen map when MOVA_LIVEOPS absent and map nonempty; exact '0' blocks fallback then becomes None. Live mode may retry euphemism base when its own operation is absent. operation_record counts opening lesson cues plus STRONG pupil cues excluding entry word; unique positive plurality wins. facts_in appends qualified numbers/stemmed units. improved_from keeps last lowercase-key row.

opchoice uses op_of for operation cues; mentions calls facts_of only when prior facts empty and MOVA_DICTFACTS present. op_in delegates to pure operation_record after lookup. facts depend on numbers::normalize and mentions::stem. No freeze command or dictionary write executed.
inverse: Universe: supplied records/token streams/TSV and scoped outputs with fixed stemmer. Inner absence excludes an operation on tied counts, facts n<=1 or unapproved predecessor, retained earlier duplicate rows. Linguistic mistakes remain possible.

An operation identifies compatible cue vectors, not unique definitions. None includes silence and ties. Facts erase context; TSV erases comments/overrides/extra fields. Tests enumerate all 256 count vectors in 0..3 and explicit projection families.
limitations: Partial syntax and source models; finite synthetic evidence, no general proof.
Parser/teacher, persistence and full retrieval/training paths remain unexecuted. Supplied trees require valid indices and matching original token positions.
state: Tied/all-zero cue counts produce None. Fixed resources/configuration yield deterministic projection. Cache key is original spelling, distinct from lowercase entry identity. TSV dates empty; extra fields ignored; last duplicate wins.
